summary: Rocket One Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing that its board set December 17, 2026 as the date of the 2026 annual meeting, a date more than 25 days after the one-year anniversary of the August 5, 2025 annual meeting. The filing sets shareholder deadlines: October 5, 2026 for advance-notice nominations under the bylaws, October 1, 2026 for Rule 14a-8 proxy proposals, and October 19, 2026 for Rule 14a-19 universal proxy notices. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated; this is a routine meeting-notice filing, not a special situation.
